name: sight-size-ruler
title: Sight Size Ruler
description: Specimen typography wrapped in a working ruler: cap-height, x-height and baseline rules are drawn to scale behind the glyphs, and hovering a rule calls out its name — type anatomy as an interactive diagram.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Hover Callout: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
